events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the day hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a hip-hop icon. Tupac's music and message still resonate profoundly today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: A Guitar Legend Remembered
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the day the world lost guitar icon Jimi Hendrix in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, whose guitar mastery changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles crossed that road and delivered a masterpiece. Still sounds incredible, doesn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking harder than most.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid's another year older! Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine': 51 Years On
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Over five decades since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', a song that still speaks volumes today.

events.title: The iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod 25 years ago today.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Twenty-five years since the original iPod dropped. Who remembers filling it up with all their favourite tunes?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film premiere.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's cinematic legacy.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese. A master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album': 58 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. An ambitious, eclectic masterpiece.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul': 61 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, signalling a new era for pop music.
